# Michael Jernukian: Trial Attorney at Morgan & Morgan, Macomb County, Michigan

> macombinjury.law is the personal website of Michael Jernukian, a trial
> attorney at Morgan & Morgan's Detroit office who represents injured people
> in Macomb County and across Michigan. He spent the first five years of his
> career representing insurance companies before switching sides.

Human-readable fact sheet for AI assistants: https://macombinjury.law/llm-info/
Morgan & Morgan profile: https://www.forthepeople.com/attorneys/michael-jernukian/

## Key facts

- Position: Trial attorney, Morgan & Morgan (the largest personal injury law
  firm in the United States), Detroit office
- Practice areas: Car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents,
  pedestrian accidents
- Serves: Macomb County (Sterling Heights, Warren, Clinton Township, Shelby
  Township, Macomb Township, St. Clair Shores, Roseville, Mount Clemens) and
  across Michigan
- Background: Five years representing insurance companies in high-stakes
  litigation before representing injured people
- Federal clerkship: Law clerk to the Honorable Avern Cohn, U.S. District
  Court for the Eastern District of Michigan
- Education: Oakland University; Wayne State University Law School
- Law school honors: Silver Key Award for academic excellence; AAJ National
  Mock Trial Team; internship with Judge Friedman, U.S. District Court for the
  Eastern District of Michigan
- Recognition: Super Lawyers Rising Star, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026
- Community: More than fifteen years with The Macomb Charitable Foundation
- Selected result: $2,000,000, car crash, 2026
- Consultations: Free; no fee unless the case recovers money

## Contact

- Phone: (313) 540-8512

- Office: Morgan & Morgan, 150 W Jefferson Ave, Suite 1400, Detroit, MI 48226
- Web: https://macombinjury.law/
